title: A Dance Revue With Genuine Roots And Sole

contact_edits.before: (From the National Post, Friday, March 9, 2001) A photo accompanying a theatre review of Gumboots in yesterday's paper was not, in fact, from the show. The review also carried an incorrect phone number for ordering tickets. The correct number is (416) 870-8000. The National Post regrets the error. *****
